title: Ledgerly
summary: Personal finance that explains your month: accounts, budgets, bills and insights.
description: A personal finance app for balances, budgets and bills, private to each member: sign in as a second member and none of the first one's money is visible. Recurring bills post themselves daily and an over-budget check flags spending as it happens.
roles_summary: Members sign up and manage only their own money.
includes: Dashboard with balances and a spending donut
